name: Map
tip: Your check-ins are white pins, stations giving check-ins nearby are green, events are amber. Tap a pin for its details and coordinates.

name: Nearby
tip: Stations in reach now. Tap Check in: the station answers with a signed check-in and its badge.

children.name: nearby
children.empty:
Check-ins happen near a station: in the same room or building over Bluetooth, WiFi or the local network, or within LoRa range when you allow it.

Walk up to a station and it shows up here.

children.name: chase_regional
children.label: Check in over LoRa too
children.tip: Off: in person only (Bluetooth, WiFi, local network). On: a station within LoRa range may answer too. Never over the internet.

children.name: log
children.empty: Your check-ins land here, newest first. Tap one to see the evidence: the station's signed certificate and your ask.

children.name: badges
children.empty: Every station hands out its badge with a check-in, and an event hands out its own. They collect here, with how many times you earned each.

name: Explore
tip: Stations giving check-ins and check-in events, nearest first. Tap one for its details and coordinates to paste into your navigation app.

children.name: events
children.empty: Stations that give check-ins and share where they are show up here, nearest first, and so do check-in events. Tap one for its details and coordinates.

name: My station
tip: Give check-ins to people who come by. To answer while the app is closed, long-press Check-in on the home screen and turn on Run in background.

children.name: bot_on
children.label: Give check-ins
children.tip: Answer people nearby who ask for a check-in.

children.name: local_only
children.label: In person only
children.tip: On: only over Bluetooth, WiFi or the local network. Off: within LoRa range too.

children.name: intro
children.label: About this station
children.tip: A line about your station for people deciding whether to visit, shown with its pin on their map.

name: Guestbook
tip: Your badge, your events and everyone who checked in at your station.

children.name: guests
children.empty: People who check in at your station are listed here, with your badge and your events above them.

name: New event
tip: It starts now. Check-ins during it carry its name and its badge.

children.name: ev_desc
children.label: About it
children.tip: A few words: the event travels as one signed packet with its badge and place.

children.name: remove_entry
children.label: Remove from logbook
children.confirm-text: It leaves your logbook, the map and your stats, and its badge leaves your wall unless another check-in earned it too. The station keeps its own guestbook.
